name: lot-map
when_to_use: A pane beside the chat should draw a live map of what Claude is doing: tool calls, agents, skills, hooks, memory and the context ring.

context_cost.note: no model calls, no network, adds nothing to the conversation (PRIVACY.md and grep of hooks for version 0.14.1; not yet measured)

risks: Third-party plugin that follows its main branch; it is handed the full input of every tool call (commands, paths, prompts) and keeps only short names. Read the diff before updating past 0.14.1. Shares one plugin pane with flow-panel as a tab.
